implementation: Admin PATCH participation changes require restaurant-admin access and password confirmation, and responses remain private/no-store.
The public service derives the authenticated operator context, validated managed topic, database client, and current connection fence server-side.
Enable uses provider-first account participation followed by the exact-fenced database link.
Disable unlinks the database participation first and reconciles Google only when the account refcount reaches zero, preserving unrelated event types and topic.
Disconnect completes notification participation teardown before starting revocation; uncertain teardown prevents token revocation.
Conflicting account topics map to the safe GBP_NOTIFICATION_TOPIC_CONFLICT response contract.

scenarios.observable: 10 suites and 33 tests passed with zero failures; teardown-before-revoke, uncertain teardown, exact fence, password authorization, provider-first attach, DB-first detach, refcount preservation, and conflict mapping covered
